description: Preview which wallets in a batch (Solana or EVM) already have a fresh paid analysis by this payer, so payout_batch would not charge for them again. This reveals a payer's own analysis history, so it needs the paying wallet's signed session; the MCP carries no session, so it always returns { paid: [] } and the batch charges every destination. Exposed for parity. Returns { paid: string[] }.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: The paid analysis tools, same as the batch.

payer.description: The paying wallet (base58 on Solana, 0x on EVM).

recipients.description: The destination wallets, same list as the batch.

token.description: The batch token address, same as the batch. Required on EVM, ignored on Solana.

name: payout_reuse
